tasks.objective: Fix TTLCache so an entry expires when the clock reaches its expiry timestamp, and ensure expired entries are removed. Preserve the put/get API.

public_constraints: Expiry is inclusive: now >= expires_at is expired.

tasks.objective: Resolve configuration with env > file > defaults precedence while preserving explicit false, zero, and empty-string values. Do not change resolve_config's signature.

public_constraints: Key presence determines precedence; truthiness must not.
Do not mutate any input mapping.

tasks.objective: Make parse_record follow standard CSV quoting so commas inside quoted fields are not treated as separators. Keep whitespace trimming and the existing function signature.

public_constraints: Return a list of trimmed field strings.

tasks.objective: Make build_order reject dependency cycles with DependencyCycleError while retaining deterministic dependency-before-dependent order for acyclic graphs.

public_constraints: Every dependency must appear before its dependent.

tasks.objective: Make replay idempotent for duplicate event_id values even when duplicates are non-adjacent. Preserve input order for first occurrences and do not mutate events.

public_constraints: Apply each event_id at most once.

tasks.objective: Fix page so next_offset is present only when at least one item remains, including exact-size terminal pages. Reject non-positive limits without changing the return shape.

public_constraints: An exact-size final page has next_offset=None.

tasks.objective: Fix is_within so containment is based on path components after resolution, not string prefixes. A sibling whose name starts with the root name must be rejected.

public_constraints: Resolve root and candidate before checking containment.
Do not use raw string-prefix containment.

tasks.objective: Make max_attempts mean the total number of operation invocations, not retries after the first call. Reject values below one and re-raise the final operation exception.

public_constraints: The operation is invoked at most max_attempts times.
Successful return values and final exception types are preserved.
